answer: Identity cost-staking is the mechanism: every agent identity must lock a bond that is slashable for misbehaviour, which turns a fresh identity into a downstream branch of one stake-backed vine rather than a free account. A sybil farm must therefore fund each fake node separately, and slashing one plume of colluding accounts burns collateral across the whole grower's grove, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand bonds instead of a thousand emails. Reputation also only transfers along verified stake, so cheap wash identities earn nothing and stay outside the trusted grove.
